description: Official FIFA World Cup 2026 knockout bracket. 12 group winners (1X), 12 runners-up (2X) and the 8 best third-placed teams (3:groups) feed the Round of 32. Slot codes: '1A'=winner group A, '2A'=runner-up group A, '3:A/B/C/D/F'=a 3rd-placed team from one of those groups (assigned by the best-third allocation), 'W74'=winner of match 74.
third_place_allocation_note: FIFA uses a fixed 495-row lookup table mapping the set of 8 groups whose 3rd-placed teams qualify to the specific R32 slots. This project reproduces a VALID allocation via constraint matching (each 3rd-place slot lists its eligible groups; the 8 qualified thirds are assigned so no team meets a side from its own group and every slot is filled). The set of teams a given 3rd-placed team can meet is exactly correct; the precise slot may differ from FIFA's table in rare combinations.
